name: WalletWasabi
description: WalletWasabi discovers releases through Nostr relays using the Wasabi team public key and passes newer releases to its updater; signature enforcement before installation remains a updater-boundary observation requiring that implementation.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; historical released artifact behavior may differ.
